data.text:
K.Velan vs Mr.R.Lalvena on 14 June, 2024 
Author: M.S. Ramesh
Bench: M.S. Ramesh
 Cont.
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras
 Dated: 14.06.2024
 Coram
 The Honourable Mr. Justice M.S. Ramesh
 Cont.P.No.959 of 2024
 K.Velan ... Peti
 Vs.
 Mr.R.Lalvena, I.A.S.,
 Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration,
 Dms Campus, Teynampet,
 Chennai  06. ...  Resp  Prayer : Contempt Petition filed under Section 11 of Contempt of Court  Act, praying to punish the respondent for committing contempt of Court  willfully disobeying the order passed in WP.No.16005 of 2022 dated  30.10.2023.
 For Petitioner : Mr.S.Sivakumar  For Respondent : Mrs.S.Anitha  Special Government Pleade  1/2 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis  C K.Velan vs Mr.R.Lalvena on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100269330/
1  M.S.
 
 ORDER The order passed in the Writ Petition has been upheld by a Division Bench in W.A.No.1311 of 2024 and an order of stay has also been granted on 26.04.2024. 
2. While that being so, it would not be appropriate for this Court to parallely adjudicate the Contempt Petition, when the Hon'ble Division Bench has seized off the matter. However, a liberty is hereby granted to the petitioner to work out his remedy subject to the outcome of the Writ Appeal. 
3. With the above liberty, the Contempt Petition stands closed.
